deploybot: created tag v3.4.1-rc2 from branch main (sha: abcdef12) and pushed to staging. Canaries planned: EU -> US -> global. quick changelog below. /cc @release-manager

deploybot: ```Changelog (high level):
- perf: improve KV cache hot-path (reduces p95 gen latency)
- fix: allocator edge-case causing OOM on long prompts
- feat: add structured output hinting to chat API
- infra: tweak batching defaults for small prompts
```
elena: can we pin dedicated pools for the canary? last time we saw OOMs in eu-west1.
ops-ana: there are no DB migrations in this release, right? saw a mention in PR #432 but looks reverted.
samir: CI green but perf job flaky — recommend small canary (5%) in eu-west for 20m, then 10% us-central for 20m. monitor p95 and error-rate.
release-manager: +1 to samir. Plan: staging canary EU 20m -> US 20m -> global stagger. Rollback condition: errors > 5% or latency regression > 30%. Rollback target: v3.4.0.
kyle: I'll pin mobile-prod routes to stable until we pass 50% global. ping me when 50% reached.
elena: SGTM. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/r/abcd — will watch OOMs and GPU mem.
deploybot: started canary: v3.4.1-rc2 -> eu-west1 (5%) | started at 2191234575.
ops-ana: noted, monitoring DB connections and hooks.
deploybot: eu-west1 canary finished: errors=0, latency +2% (within threshold). proceeding to us-central1 10%.
samir: if us latency >20% roll back immediately. tagging @eng-sre.
deploybot: us-central1 canary finished: errors=0, latency +4%. rolling out global in staggered 25% steps every 5m.
release-manager: rolling to global now. @kyle please unpin when we hit 50% stable.
kyle: :thumbsup: will unpin at 50% and open rollback PR if anything weird pops up.
deploybot: published release tag v3.4.1 (from rc2). Release notes: https://releases.redwood.ai/3.4.1 — short summary in notes.
elena: any post-release smoke tasks? I'll trigger the quick smoke suite against prod.
deploybot: smoke suite passed on prod. closing this thread.
